description: Read one to twenty published references together in schema_refs, including a one-element list for one definition. Collect known references for the next action and batch them instead of calling once per field. Returns definitions keyed by reference and shared, reference-closed components. Reuse them at the same name/version; profile output and profile_patch input are distinct. result_reading describes expanded user-facing reading content and field meanings, not integer record tables from the separate full-reading API. Invalid references or oversized batches fail explicitly; split a rejected batch without omitting constraints. Avoid full profile definitions unless needed. Requires the authenticated One U Education account and declared planning scope; credentials and user identity are never tool arguments.

schema_refs.description: Collect needed published schema_ref values and read them together, even for one reference. Same schema name/version only; definitions are keyed by reference and components are shared. Invalid references or an oversized batch fail explicitly.

version.description: Reuse definitions only for the same schema name/version. Only the current version is served.

name: get_planning_schema_definition
title: Read an authoritative planning definition
